takeaway: The radar's forecasts recovered: the Oct 28 ranking scored a rank correlation of 0.70 and got 60% of its top 15 right. Computer-use agents lead today's new growth: vercel-labs/agent-desktop gained 2,601 stars in a day.

findings.heading: Forecasts recover
findings.text: The Oct 28 ranking scored 0.70 (rank correlation) and 60% of its top 15, across 91 apps, after 0.53 to 0.61 for Oct 25 to 27. Random picks would get about 16%.

findings.heading: Computer use for agents: agent-desktop
findings.text: vercel-labs/agent-desktop went from 10,793 to 13,394 stars in a day (+24%). The DeepSeek Harness phone client dsh-Go sped up to 1,985 a day.

findings.heading: Scrapling accelerates for a third day
findings.text: D4Vinci/Scrapling, an adaptive web scraper, gained 648, 1,408 and then 1,954 stars a day, to 95,300.

findings.heading: Applied Compute reaches a $100M run rate
findings.text: The company announced a $100M run rate with a $350M raise on Nov 2. Read from search results.

caveats: Ten matured forecasts; the recovery on Oct 28 is one point, and it predates the API data.
Trending pages listed 13 to 17 repos today, fewer than usual.
Company figures come from search-result summaries.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
